baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ and مُنتَهَىٰهَا bind direction, lordship, and final limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sovereign ownership and the reached extremity converge: the event's destination and authority over that destination terminate with the addressee's Lord.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and mastery supply the governing pole to which the limit is assigned.
A reached goal or extremity supplies the terminal point governed by that Lord.

changed_reading.before: It has an endpoint related to your Lord.
changed_reading.after: Its final destination and jurisdiction over that destination terminate exclusively with your Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبِّكَ can name one who tends a thing to completion, while مُنتَهَىٰ names its attained end.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord's stagewise tending turns the end from a bare stopping date into a telos brought to completion under care and governance.

activation_trace.role: Repairing, nurturing, and completing supply a process that carries a thing stage by stage.
The attained goal supplies the completion toward which that process moves.

changed_reading.before: The Lord knows or owns a terminal instant.
changed_reading.after: The Lord brings the event's whole course to its appointed completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُنتَهَىٰ retains the root's stopping and restraining potential beside sovereign رَبِّكَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The endpoint functions as an authoritative boundary: pursuit, agency, or explanation can proceed only until lordly sovereignty stops it.

activation_trace.role: Restraint and cessation make the terminus function as a stopping boundary rather than only a location.
Sovereignty assigns authority for that boundary to the Lord.

changed_reading.before: The line merely locates the event's end.
changed_reading.after: The line also sets a lordly stopping boundary on further pursuit or control.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh crosses a limit, claims the highest lordship, and is seized in exemplary punishment; the focus line generalizes that reversal by locating every sovereignty claim's final limit at the true Lord.

activation_trace.role: True lordship and mastery anchor the focus line's terminal jurisdiction.
The final extremity supplies the limit at which rival rule fails.
Exceeding the limit in rebellion characterizes the rival claim as boundary violation.
The claimed lordship makes sovereignty itself the contested relation.
Exalted greatness and tyranny supply the claimant's vertical assertion of supremacy.
Being taken to account supplies the reversal that terminates the claim.
Exemplary punishment makes that termination publicly deterrent.

structural_cues: 79:16 and 79:19 establish his/your Lord; 79:24 counterclaims your highest lord; 79:25 immediately reverses the claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the rival title, exceeded limit, and seizure; I infer that 79:44 turns this narrative reversal into a general terminal jurisdiction. Alternatively, the narrative may remain only an exemplum rather than directly specifying مُنتَهَىٰ.

changed_reading.before: The event's end belongs to the Lord in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: Every borrowed or rival lordship reaches its limit, while final jurisdiction remains with your true Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation is assembled, raised, completed, tended, stabilized, and extended for use; this sequence activates رَبّ as completer and مُنتَهَىٰ as the culmination of an already governed order.

activation_trace.role: Nurturing and completion provide the focus anchor for staged governance.
The attained goal turns those stages toward a determinate culmination.
Measured proportion supplies deliberate ordering before completion.
Joining parts into a built whole supplies constructive staging.
Raising supplies the upward construction stage named in the mechanism.
Straightness and intrinsic completion mark a created stage brought to integrity.
Pasture's shepherding image echoes protective tending within the created provision.
Fixing and stabilizing the mountains supplies ordered settlement.
Extension that reaches its limit links provision itself to a bounded course.

structural_cues: 79:27-33 is a serial construction-provision sequence whose verbs move from building and completion to stabilization and use.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered sequence of making, completing, tending, and stabilizing; I infer that the same governor brings the Hour to completion. A live alternative is that the sequence proves capability only, without describing how its end unfolds.

changed_reading.before: The end is an isolated secret held by the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The end is the culmination of the same stagewise governance visible throughout the created order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preference for the lower life is opposed to fearing the Lord's standing and stopping the self at desire, after which contrasting refuges gather each course; the final limit thus has a present ethical rehearsal in self-limitation.

activation_trace.role: Lordship anchors the authority before which both present restraint and final outcome stand.
The attained endpoint supplies the final limit toward which the paired courses move.
Preferential choice supplies one course's active orientation.
The lower and nearer life supplies the proximate object chosen over the farther end.
The repeated Lord relation joins ethical stance directly to the focus anchor.
Active restraint repeats the focus root as a practiced stopping at a boundary.
The inward rational self supplies the site at which the stopping boundary is enacted.
Inclination of the self supplies the motion being checked.
Joining a gathering refuge converts moral orientation into a terminal destination.

structural_cues: 79:37-41 pairs transgression and preference with fear and restraint, then assigns contrasting refuges; 79:40 repeats both focus roots together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact ر ب ب/ن ه ي echo and paired refuges; I infer that restraining desire locally rehearses the final limit and orients the self toward an outcome. Alternatively, the echo may provide rhetorical cohesion without making present restraint a model of the Hour's end.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's endpoint is wholly external and future.
changed_reading.after: The final limit is foreshadowed ethically whenever the self is stopped at desire, with each chosen course gathering into its refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: A request for the Hour's mooring is followed by a limit placed with the Lord, a warning role, and an experienced duration compressed to part of a day; the line redirects clock-seeking toward divine settlement and practical readiness.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign mastery receives the settlement and decisive knowledge redirected from the questioner.
The attained goal answers the adjacent image of a fixed settling point.
Request and inquiry initiate the search for when the Hour will occur.
Fixity and settlement frame the requested time as the Hour's point of becoming established.
Reminder marks a communicative function at the boundary of disclosed timing.
Warning that awakens caution replaces timetable delivery as the messenger's operative role.
Retrospective dwelling is compressed, destabilizing ordinary measures of elapsed duration.
A familiar part-day interval gives the compressed duration a concrete temporal scale.

structural_cues: 79:42-46 forms a question-response-role-experience sequence, while repeated feminine -ها links the Hour, its mooring/end, warning-object, and sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inquiry, mooring, reminder, warning, and a short experienced interval; I infer that 79:44 redirects chronology into lordly authority and readiness. A live alternative is narrower: مُنتَهَىٰ may mean only that knowledge of the date rests with the Lord.

changed_reading.before: The line states generally that the Hour has a Lord-owned endpoint.
changed_reading.after: It answers a demand for timing by assigning the Hour's fixed settlement and decisive knowledge to the Lord, while assigning humans warning rather than a timetable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines peripheral nautical and hydrological branches, including rabbani as a sailors' chief, across distant verses. It remains anchored in focus رَبِّ/مُنتَهَى and adjacent مُرْسَى, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, never as the lexical replacement of your Lord.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَبِّ at word 2 and مُنتَهَىٰ at word 3 can participate in a contained captain-basin image.

activation_trace.role: The chief of sailors supplies an exploratory governing figure for a voyage-like mechanism.
Water settling where a flood ends supplies a material image of terminal collection.
Swimming or running supplies movement through a medium toward that terminus.
A ship coming to rest at its mooring supplies the immediate terminal image.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint is an abstract deadline.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, the Hour is a voyage or current whose final basin and mooring lie under its divine master.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر ب و mapping for focus ر ب ب and joins separated elevation cues. It remains focus-anchored through رَبِّ and مُنتَهَىٰ, but should be rendered only as a vertical metaphor, not as etymological equivalence or divine localization.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus ر ب ب to an increase/elevation branch, while مُنتَهَىٰ supplies the ceiling or culmination.

activation_trace.role: Increase and elevation supply an exploratory upward vector within the focus root's split mapping.
The attained extremity supplies the upper vector's terminal ceiling.
Height supplies Pharaoh's asserted vertical supremacy.
Raising the heaven supplies a legitimate created ascent distinct from the rival claim.
The lower life supplies the counter-pole to ascent and culmination.

changed_reading.before: The verse only assigns a temporal endpoint.
changed_reading.after: As a vertical metaphor, every growth, elevation, and supremacy claim reaches its ceiling at your Lord.

strongest_changes: The adjacent mooring question turns the line from a date statement into a transfer of fixed settlement and decisive knowledge to the Lord.
The exact ر ب ب/ن ه ي echo in 79:40 makes the final limit ethically present as restraint of the self toward a contrasting refuge.
Pharaoh's rival lordship claim and seizure make the endpoint the termination of borrowed sovereignty.
summary.what_was_special: Both focus roots recur together in 79:40, while مُرْسَىٰ immediately before and compressed lived duration after create a settlement-versus-clock contrast; peripheral water and elevation branches also sustain contained analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether مُنتَهَىٰ chiefly denotes the Lord's knowledge of the date, the event's actual endpoint, or both.
Whether the ethical, nautical, and vertical activations are rhetorical overlays rather than direct lexical force.
